preconditions.description: The input word is a non-empty string with length strictly between 0 and 1000.

postconditions.description: If the word length is odd, the returned string is exactly the single middle character at index len(word) // 2.
If the word length is even, the returned string is exactly the two middle characters at indices len(word) // 2 - 1 and len(word) // 2.
